original: 肉を食べる前に細かく切るべきです。

en.text: You should cut up your meat before you eat it.
You should cut the meat into small pieces before eating it.

indices: 肉(にく)[02] を 食べる 前(まえ) に 細かい[01]{細かく} 切る[01] 可き{べき} です

original: 宇宙服は宇宙飛行士たちを細かな宇宙塵との衝突による怪我から守る。

en.text: Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.
